      "comment": "needs-a-human: clarify whether legacy column ordering must restore historical Envers audit primary-key order.

Source-based triage at upstream 01fe3ffce698bb655a7ddb470766e3f74339220c; no compilation, executable reproduction, RED/GREEN or fix is claimed.

The reported expectation is (id, REV). The public reproducer explicitly enables legacy and asserts that metadata column sequence. However, [ColumnOrderingStrategyLegacy](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/01fe3ffce698bb655a7ddb470766e3f74339220c/hibernate-core/src/main/java/org/hibernate/boot/model/relational/ColumnOrderingStrategyLegacy.java) documents a no-op, and MetadataImpl.orderColumns skips the legacy singleton. MappingSettings names the alias without promising reconstruction of Hibernate 5 audit primary keys.

The relevant earlier path is [ModelBinder](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/01fe3ffce698bb655a7ddb470766e3f74339220c/hibernate-core/src/main/java/org/hibernate/boot/model/source/internal/hbm/ModelBinder.java#L246-L250): it sorts identifier properties before creating the primary key. [Component.sortProperties](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/01fe3ffce698bb655a7ddb470766e3f74339220c/hibernate-core/src/main/java/org/hibernate/mapping/Component.java#L852-L878) sorts by property name independently of the column-ordering strategy. Envers IdMetadataGenerator initially appends the revision relation after entity-ID attributes, but that initial insertion order need not survive binding. This is an identified code path, not proof of a failing runtime test.

Blast radius: Envers audit identifiers and core composite-identifier binding, with generated schema primary-key order affected. Difficulty is moderate to high until compatibility scope is decided.

One-way door: altering persisted-schema key order or a shared identifier-ordering contract can affect existing schemas and mappings; a generic sorting bypass is not justified.

No duplicates in this one-issue batch. Do not implement merely to satisfy the expected order. First establish whether historical Envers ordering is promised for legacy mode, the supported versions/mapping paths, and migration implications. Then obtain focused H2 Actions RED/GREEN for the agreed behavior, preserving default/custom strategies, followed by review and exact-head checks."
